## Full Conference Call Transcript
**Jereme M. Sylvain:** Thank you, Jake. As a reminder, unless otherwise noted, the financial measures presented today will be discussed on a non-GAAP basis. Reconciliations to GAAP can be found in today's earnings release as well as the slide deck on our IR website. For the first quarter of 2026, we reported worldwide revenue of $1.19 billion compared to $1.04 billion for 2025, representing growth of 15% on a reported basis and 12% on an organic basis.
Adjusted EBITDA was $364.5 million, or 36% of revenue for the first quarter, compared to $230.4 million, or 22.2% of revenue for 2025. Net income for the first quarter was $216.3 million, or $0.56 per share, representing 75% growth over 2025.
**Jereme M. Sylvain:** Thanks for the question. We worked hard on free cash flow. In terms of uses of cash, you are right: we paid down our convert last quarter, and that was one reason to isolate cash. We did $500 million of share buybacks in the back half of last year. Having extra on the balance sheet provides multiple opportunities: tuck-in M&A that makes sense—geographic expansion or capabilities we do not have—and having capital for potential capital markets activity. We have not been shy about share buybacks.

jina.title: Dexcom Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
jina.snippet:
DexCom, Inc. (Nasdaq: DXCM) today reported its financial results as of and for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.

**Third Quarter 2026 Financial Highlights:**

*   Revenue grew 11% year-over-year to $1.344 billion on a reported basis and 11% year-over-year on an organic 1 basis.
*   U.S. revenue grew 14% and international revenue grew 5% on a reported basis and 5% on an organic 1 basis, all on a year-over-year basis.
*   GAAP operating income of $327.2 million or 24.3% of revenue, an increase of 420 basis points compared to the third quarter of 2025. Non-GAAP operating income* of $339.5 million or 25.3% of reported revenue, an increase of 270 basis points compared to the third quarter of 2025.

**Third Quarter 2026 Strategic Highlights:**

*   Subsequent to the quarter, published the CONNECT randomized clinical trial in _The New England Journal of Medicine_, showcasing outcomes driven by Dexcom G7 that redefine the standard of care for people with Type 2 diabetes not on insulin.
*   Launched the fully redesigned Stelo experience, with enhanced glucose insights, simplified meal logging, and more detailed nutritional information.
*   Advanced the rollout of the Dexcom G7 15 Day System in the U.S. and secured first two G7 15 Day international regulatory clearances, positioning for continued momentum in the transition of the global base to the extended wear platform.

“This quarter, we continued to build momentum across the business, delivering strong revenue growth and margin progression, strengthening our clinical evidence, and advancing key product and operational initiatives,” said Jake Leach, Dexcom’s president and CEO. “This performance enabled us to again raise our full-year revenue and operating margin guidance and reinforces our confidence in our ability to deliver on the long-term objectives we outlined at Investor Day.”

## Q4 2025 earnings summary

20 Apr, 2026

### Executive summary

- Q4 2025 revenue reached $1.26 billion, up 13% year-over-year, driven by strong new customer demand and the successful G7 15-Day product launch.

- CEO outlined strategic priorities: premier glucose sensing, customer experience excellence, and international market expansion.

- Significant operational improvements in manufacturing and logistics led to higher inventory and improved gross margin.

- FDA clearance received for Smart Basal insulin optimizer and new patch technology, with early access launch in Q1 2026.

- Stelo contributed $130 million in 2025 revenue, with new app features planned for 2026.

### Financial highlights

- Q4 2025 worldwide revenue was $1.26 billion, up from $1.11 billion in Q4 2024 (13% growth reported, 12% organic).

- U.S. revenue grew 11% to $892 million; international revenue rose 18% to $368 million, with France as a standout market.

- 2026 revenue guidance: $5.16–$5.25 billion, representing 11–13% growth, assuming stable coverage and incremental contributions from Stelo and new products.
